# Hill Mole

> Hill Mole is Chris Abraham's serialized spy novel, published as a weblog at hillmole.com from May 2005 to June 2022: {{ site.posts.size }} short entries in which a man working in Washington, DC, slowly realizes he may be a mole amid the spycraft and intrigue around him.

The entries are fiction, written in the first person, and are meant to be read in order from the first. Each entry has a permanent URL in the form /archives/YYYY/MM/name.html that has not changed since it was published. The text is © Chris Abraham; quote with attribution and a link to the entry.

- [Full text of every entry]({{ '/llms-full.txt' | absolute_url }}): plain text, oldest first
- [Start at the beginning]({{ site.posts.last.url | absolute_url }}): "{{ site.posts.last.title }}", {{ site.posts.last.date | date: "%B %-d, %Y" }}
- [Latest entry]({{ site.posts.first.url | absolute_url }}): "{{ site.posts.first.title }}", {{ site.posts.first.date | date: "%B %-d, %Y" }}
- [The star-nosed mole]({{ '/archives/2005/08/star-nosed_mole.html' | absolute_url }}): the creature in the banner
- [About Hill Mole]({{ '/about.html' | absolute_url }}): what it is, who wrote it, where to start
- [All entries]({{ '/archives.html' | absolute_url }}): every entry by date
